data_generating_process.concentration_case: 29 distinct cluster values in [0,0.02], one at 1.0
data_generating_process.estimand: zero linear association under the null
data_generating_process.factor: continuous numeric exposure fixed within each cluster
data_generating_process.limitations: Synthetic unconditional null challenge; threshold is a cautious abstention rule and does not establish conditional coverage or validate a universal production cutoff.
data_generating_process.lower_cluster_count_case: 20 clusters balanced across five exposure levels; held-out benchmark measured 93.58% CR1 interval coverage and P4 now withholds uncertainty under its 20 effective-information-cluster heuristic
data_generating_process.outcome: independent cluster intercept N(0,1) plus row noise N(0,0.5)
data_generating_process.supported_case: 50 equally spaced cluster exposures from -1 to 1

decision: Withhold clustered uncertainty for multi-level numeric factors constant within clusters when effective between-cluster information is below 20. The balanced 20-cluster case had 93.58% reference coverage and is now withheld; the well-spread 50-cluster case remains inferential and falls within the benchmark Wilson interval. This finite synthetic challenge justifies a conservative refusal heuristic, not a universal cutoff or coverage promise.

method.interpretation: conservative abstention heuristic only, not an inferential effective sample size, df correction, or coverage guarantee
